data.title: Black Monday Fears Rise As $33M In AI Chip Bets Get Liquidated: Bitcoin Near Danger Zone
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC) traded just above a cluster of leveraged long bets on Sunday. Traders who piled into AI chip stocks lost about $33.8 million on crypto exchanges a day earlier. The wipeout hit contracts tied to Micron (MU), SanDisk (SNDK) and SK Hynix (SKHY)
